summary: Iteration 25 (frontend-only) validated all Pantry, expiration-alerts settings, best-day-to-buy and sparkline features on the Iron Rabbit PWA. Seeded IndexedDB directly with 4 pantry items (today / expired-1d / +3d / +10d) and 6 Milk trips across Mon/Wed/Sat. All critical flows PASS: pantry modal opens, empty state ready, add-item full form works, expiration badges render with correct colors, qty +/- work, qty=1 use → confirm dialog → item removed and 'Shopping List created with Today Milk' toast shown (verified visually), zone + expiration + search filters all filter correctly, edit modal pre-fills, delete-confirm removes item, Settings NotificationsPanel exposes notif-toggle-pantry-expiration and persists to settings.notif_pantry_expiration. Trip Journal 'Most bought & best day to buy' renders trip-top-items with best-day-milk badge showing exactly 'Best: Mons · save 22%' (matches expected ±1%) and sparkline-milk with recharts SVG. All 4 header buttons (meal-planner, barcode, trip-journal, pantry) remain visible — no regression.

ui_bugs.issue: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' triggered when the Pantry edit modal (Unit Select) renders. Likely from SelectItem list where an item resolves to duplicate/empty key. Non-blocking but should be fixed.
Hydration warning: '<button> cannot be a descendant of <button>' appears when the Trip Journal modal opens. Nested interactive elements need refactoring.

action_items: Optional: fix React key warning in PantryModal's Unit Select (Radix SelectItem list). Non-blocking.
Optional: fix nested <button> hydration warning inside TripJournalModal (best-day badge/trigger nested inside an outer button).

Optional (code review): /app/frontend/src/storage/storageService.js defines exportAllData/importAllData TWICE (line 159 and 371 / 195 and 409); second implementation silently shadows the first. Consolidate to one canonical version to avoid drift.

Optional (doc drift): /app/frontend/src/utils/priceHistory.js JSDoc says 'at least 3 different weekdays' but code checks `byDay.size < 2` (i.e. requires 2 weekdays). Update comment or logic to align — logic is correct for the requested behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: storageService.js has duplicated exportAllData / importAllData functions (JS silently keeps the second definition). This is a real bug because the two versions differ in shape (`app` vs `version`, `files` structure). Recommend keeping the v1.1 version and deleting the earlier one.
PantryModal.jsx passes `style={active ? undefined : { color: undefined }}` on zone edit buttons — no-op; safe to remove.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (12/12 critical checks passed; 2 low-severity console warnings)

seed_data_creation: Seeded settings.pantry_items[] with 4 items (Today Milk / Old Yogurt / Fresh Bread / Frozen Peas) and settings.grocery_trips[] with 6 Milk trips (Mon×3 @ $3.50/$3.50/$3.60, Wed×2 @ $4.50, Sat×1 @ $4.20) directly via IndexedDB. Also set tour_completed=true and quick_access_wizard_seen=true to skip onboarding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iteration-25 pantry + best-day + sparkline features validated end-to-end via Playwright against the deployed preview URL. Best-day math verified: Mon median $3.50, Sat median $4.20, Wed median $4.50 → savings = (4.50-3.50)/4.50 = 22.2% ≈ 22% (matches product expectation). If next iteration touches Pantry or TripJournalModal, please also verify the two React console warnings (list-key in PantryModal Unit Select, nested-button hydration in TripJournalModal) which are pre-existing low-severity.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Two console-only React warnings noted but do not affect behavior.
